core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haleema corresponds to the Arabic form حليمة (Arabic root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m); حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma)). Its core sense is patient, forbearing, gentle. Haleema is Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma) 'patient, forbearing (feminine)', from the root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m). It is the name of Ḥalīma as-Saʿdiyya, the wet-nurse of the Prophet Muḥammad — a documented historical bearer, not an invented one. The source gloss 'generous, kind' is a loose rendering; 'patient, forbearing' is the lexical sense.
